label: About
title: About Artist Company Filing Vessel
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1209 recent saved-signal files and 314 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @ystrickler: For the first time ever, a law has been proposed that would create a business... and @heynavtoor: You have a shoebox full of receipts. A folder of tax documents you have not touched..., plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Artist Company Filing Vessel: Architectural section of a public-scale document vessel, cut open into horizontal strata of receipts, contract sheets, manila boards, and cool archival slabs. A heavy artist-company registry block interrupts the older bureaucracy, seated like new law inside paper geology. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against large oxidized registry slab with circular seal, upper document strata and paper stacks, and cyan horizontal glass scan rail.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
